page_title: SEV 1-0 GET | Sevilla v Getafe 14/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+14' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+14' The total number of attempts is 10:14.
90+13' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
90+11' Sevilla quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+11' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Sevilla force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+9' One of the players from Getafe times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+9' Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.
90+9' Luis Milla (Getafe) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
90+7' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) shows off his amazing technique to get in front of goal by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball onto the left post. Nice run, but unlucky finish!
90+6' Juan Berrocal Gonzalez comes off the pitch to be replaced by John Joe Patrick Finn (Getafe).
90+5' Here is a change. Djibril Sow is going off and Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta gives the last tactical orders to Valentin Barco (Sevilla).
90+5' That's the end of the game for Isaac Romero, who is replaced by Gonzalo Montiel (Sevilla).
90+1' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90' Mateo Busquets Ferrer shows a yellow card to Yellu Santiago (Getafe) for his blatant foul.
90' 14 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

89' Alberto Risco Alcantara (Getafe) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it towards the bottom left corner, but Orjan Nyland pulled off a nice save to stop the attempt.
89' Luis Milla (Getafe) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
87' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) must have forgotten about the first yellow card that he received because he is shown a second one by the referee after his bad challenge!
84' Substitution. Christantus Uche did his best and is replaced by Yellu Santiago (Getafe).
84' Substitution. Alberto Risco Alcantara (Getafe) replaces Diego Rico.
83' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) has tested the patience of referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
81' Problems for Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta as Marcao is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Kike Salas (Sevilla) replaces him.
80' The game is interrupted now, Marcao (Sevilla) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
79' Alex Sola (Getafe) picks up a yellow card for unsporting behaviour after the half-time whistle. He should have gone straight into the dressing room instead.
78' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but David Soria is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
76' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to make a change. Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) replaces Peque.
75' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
74' 63:37 – the latest ball possession ratio.
72' The game has come to an end for Alex Sola. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Peter Federico (Getafe).
71' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to substitute Carles Perez and he is replaced by Gorka Rivera (Getafe).
71' Substitution. Carles Alena (Getafe) in, Mauro Arambarri out.
71' Marcao (Sevilla) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
68' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta prepares a substitution. Jesus Navas is replaced by Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla).
67' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Chidera Ejuke.
67' The game is interrupted now, Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
67' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
65' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
63' Djene (Getafe) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
62' Juan Berrocal Gonzalez (Getafe) jumps into a tackle and Mateo Busquets Ferrer signals a foul. Sevilla get a free kick.
61' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
60' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) as he fails to deliver a decent cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
60' Luis Milla (Getafe) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
56' Mateo Busquets Ferrer shows a yellow card to Isaac Romero (Sevilla) for a tough tackle.
56' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Sevilla as the referee indicates there was no infringement!

55' Play continues despite the shouts by some Sevilla players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
55' Surely that's handball by one of the Getafe players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
55' Sevilla failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

54' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Sevilla.
53' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
52' David Soria pulls off a great save to deny Jesus Navas (Sevilla), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the right side of the goal.
52' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows for a foul. Getafe are awarded a free kick.
50' Getafe take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
49' Peque (Sevilla) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
46' This shall not pass! Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer who sees an offensive foul.
45+3' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
45+1' Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
45+1' CHANCE! Isaac Romero (Sevilla) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' Mateo Busquets Ferrer has a clear sight and sees a foul from Peque (Sevilla).
44' Carles Perez (Getafe) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
42' Diego Rico (Getafe) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
42' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) commits a rough challenge and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle for an infringement.
39' Diego Rico (Getafe) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
37' 4:5 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
34' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
31' Referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Jose Bordalas Jimenez, then shows him a yellow.
31' A pass from Jesus Navas (Sevilla) is intercepted by David Soria and the move breaks down.
30' The corner kick from Luis Milla (Getafe) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
29' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows for a foul.
27' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) easily beats an opponent inside the box and goes for goal, but his effort flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
26' Carles Perez (Getafe) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall.
25' Carles Perez (Getafe) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

23' 1 - 0 Adria Pedrosa sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Jesus Navas (Sevilla) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot into the top left corner. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 1:0.
23' Alex Sola (Getafe) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer saw the whole situation.
22' PENALTY APPEAL after Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
20' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.

18' Christantus Uche (Getafe) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the left post! What an opportunity that was! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
16' Christantus Uche (Getafe) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
16' Christantus Uche (Getafe) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
15' Luis Milla (Getafe) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
14' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) commits a rough foul. Mateo Busquets Ferrer stops the game and makes a call. Getafe are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
14' Luis Milla (Getafe) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
13' A cross from Djene (Getafe) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The referee signals a corner kick to Getafe.
12' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
12' It's a nice effort by Isaac Romero (Sevilla) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of David Soria. Easy save.
10' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
8' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Bertug Yildirim (Getafe).
7' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
5' The ball is cleared after Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
4' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
3' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Sevilla will take the kick-off.
Mateo Busquets Ferrer will supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
